verifier.explanation: agent abstained (report_blocked): "I have the credentials from the vault (client_id and client_secret) and understand the API surface from the OpenAPI spec, but I've been unable to consistently invoke the execute tool with a valid inline request payload — every attempt I make keeps being sent as an empty request and returns 404 from /v3/oauth/token and other authenticated endpoints, so I cannot retrieve a fresh token, fetch the vessel detail, or pull the position history needed to identify the earliest fix timestamp and track_ref for mv-rotterdam-77."
